Class JevDecisionModel

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.internal.JevDecisionModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
DecisionModel
public final class JevDecisionModel extends Object implements DecisionModel
The decision-model engine over a DecisionModelRuntime: it chooses the model and copies an SD-card file into PSRAM, and the runtime evaluates. Only begin(SdCard, String) allocates PSRAM, so a program that links its model also builds for boards without PSRAM.

  • Method Details

    • begin

      public ModelStatus begin()
      Description copied from interface: DecisionModel
      Uses the JEV1 model the build linked into the firmware, replacing any model loaded before. A program that calls this method must be built with -Djuno.dm.model=<file>, or the build fails. Returns ModelStatus.OK, or ModelStatus.INVALID_MODEL when the engine refuses the linked file.
      Specified by:
      begin in interface DecisionModel

    • begin

      public ModelStatus begin(SdCard card, String path)
      Description copied from interface: DecisionModel
      Loads the JEV1 file at path on card, which must already be mounted with its own SdCard.begin(), into PSRAM, replacing any model loaded before. The file is copied through a 1 KiB buffer, so call it once, at startup; it needs a board with PSRAM. Returns ModelStatus.OK, ModelStatus.UNREADABLE for a missing or unreadable file, ModelStatus.EXHAUSTED when PSRAM has no room for it, or ModelStatus.INVALID_MODEL when the engine refuses it.
      Specified by:
      begin in interface DecisionModel

    • evaluate

      public int evaluate(int[] state, int[] legalActions)
      Description copied from interface: DecisionModel
      Returns the selected action from legalActions for state, or -1 when no model is loaded, the state does not have DecisionModel.features() entries or no legal action is one of the model's.

      The buffers are read-only to the engine and remain owned by the caller.

      Specified by:
      evaluate in interface DecisionModel
